name: Diopecephalus
isnote: Widely regarded as a juvenile Pterodactylus antiquus (Jouve 2004; Bennett 2013), but resurrected by Vidovic & Martill (2017) and supported as distinct, basal pterodactyloid by Smyth & Unwin (2024). Validity debated.
sum: Small pterodactyloid from the Solnhofen limestone of Bavaria, long known as ‘Pterodactylus kochi’.
holotype: SM 404 and BSP AS.XIX.3 (holotype of P. kochi Wagner 1837) — Lower Tithonian, Solnhofen region, Bavaria.
material: Juvenile type skeleton and further specimens.
author: Seeley 1871

images.artist: Steven U. Vidovic, David M. Martill
images.caption: This file was published in a Public Library of Science journal
